description: This file defines the DevelopmentClusteringProvider class which implements the IProviderBuilder interface to configure development clustering for Orleans silos. It includes configuration logic for parsing an IPEndPoint from configuration data and sets up development clustering accordingly.

classes.name: DevelopmentClusteringProvider
classes.description: Implements IProviderBuilder for ISiloBuilder, configuring development clustering with endpoint parsing and validation.

methods.name: Configure
methods.description: Configures the ISiloBuilder with development clustering, parsing the PrimarySiloEndPoint from configuration.
